summary: Correct the two-verse range for the wind and dancing water example
rationale: The first quoted sentence is in 4/17 ("Me d lo koṯe hawa ḥəṣṭo, šalqat rabe layt"); the second is in 4/18 ("Bas am maye, d əmmət, krəqḏi b dukṯayye"). 4/16 describes the view from the speaker’s seat.

summary: Correct the consonants of the adjective describing the wind
rationale: The corpus reads "hawa ḥəṣṭo", with ḥ and ṣ, whereas the quotation has h and š. These consonant substitutions exceed the listed normalization conventions. The supplied Wörterbuch also cites 4/17 under ḥiṣo / ḥəṣto, confirming ḥ and ṣ.
The Turoyo has plural "am məṭrəb kozəmri" and the edition has plural "die Zigeuner spielten auf". The English plural verb "were" likewise requires "musicians" here.

summary: Correct the duplicated word in the English head remark
rationale: The sequence "note the the Syriac verb is rare" contains an evident slip for "note that the Syriac verb is rare".
The German name of the mulberry tree is "Maulbeerbaum"; an e is missing.
